issue_context.title: BUG: Master branch does not compile in C++ with -std=gnu++2a (IDFGH-6741)
issue_context.body:
## Environment

- Development Kit: none
- Module or chip used:  ESP32-S2
- IDF version: v5.0-dev-1519-g5810ed1d04
- Build System: idf.py
- Compiler version: xtensa-esp32s2-elf-g++ (crosstool-NG esp-2021r2) 8.4.0
- Operating System: Linux
- Using an IDE?: No

## Problem Description

[This commit](https://github.com/espressif/esp-idf/commit/c5fd79547ac9b7bae06fa660e9f814d18d3390b7) has broken the C++ build.

The following is not valid in C++ https://github.com/espressif/esp-idf/commit/c5fd79547ac9b7bae06fa660e9f814d18d3390b7#diff-08ec6194ee68acf46a8bfb6250fb32f14c5d3bc7c2d113f7b0a19fe070561d66R36-R42

And the following two snippets bring back the problem addressed here #5897 and here #6692 and solved with this commit https://github.com/jrepp/esp-idf/commit/611c092353b48e5f7fda0e340fbeb5d9d0212c8f

https://github.com/espressif/esp-idf/commit/c5fd79547ac9b7bae06fa660e9f814d18d3390b7#diff-c1b348028ea444fde69bc0cc1afdc340d7d6b0ecbcbcc569685a5b71ed051792R396-R400

review_comments: @b1ackviking Out of curiosity, is there any particular reason why you test two arguments with C++ here? Sorry for the horribly long turnaround...
I did that to emphasize that using `__VA_OPT__` to detect if there are any arguments is not equivalent to expanding the argument pack with the `##__VA_ARGS__` extension.
